title: Vanillated
description: A Vanilla++ Modpack focused on Performance!! Alot of Additions to vanilla minecraft.
body:
This is a ****Vanilla++** Modpack** made for **Low end devices** and Even **high end devices**!! It includes alot of **light** additions to minecraft which vanilla should have **added!!** Ranging from **new ores** and** weapons** to even **Planes and ships**!! It expands different aspects of Minecraft like **farming, food, transpot and compats!! **

_Dm on Discord for suggestions and support>> Hirday123Pro_
